notes.title: Dimensionals 1.0.2 Small bug patch
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! This is a small patch to address the critical issue occurring with boss encounters causing the game to soft lock. We have also added a few additional changes regarding campaign balance and Melt/Voltage interaction for the star heroes.



Campaign balance:

Removed Armored bob's attack during Season 2 Episode 5.

Bug Fixes:

Fixed Softlock bug with multiple boss encounters

Fixed Melt & Voltage interaction bug

Thank you again for your patience and we hope you all continue to enjoy Dimensionals!

Team DM

notes.title: Dimensionals 1.0.1 Unlocks, balance and bug fixes
notes.notes:
Dimensionals Patch 1.0.1, Jun 12th


Welcome to the first patch since Dimensionals officially launched in full access on steam! This patch addresses hero unlocks, campaign balance issues and bugs reported by the community.



We hope you continue to enjoy battling against the evil specters in the rift!


Updated Hero Unlocks:
Alternative unlock for Thundergust:

Players can now unlock Thundergust through the Master Raid by blocking 500 damage in the master raid.

Alternative unlock for Shadestrike:

Players can now unlock Shadestrike through the Master Raid by spending 2000 coins in the master raid.
Campaign Balance updates:
Vulcanova: 

Vulcanova passive rage gain reduced from 3 down to 1.

Vulcanova Block gain reduced from 100 to 50, Vulcanova now takes 100 damage each time his block breaks.

Season 2 Episode 5 campaign balance:

Prowler rage gain reduced from 3 to 1.

Season 3 Episode 7 campaign balance:

Player now starts with a stack of healing potions and a 3-star defend.


Bug fixes:
Arachnobro Unlock bug:

Arachnobro is now rightly unlocked by using ace of blades 52 times in one master raid run.

Small hero hitbox bug:

Hitbox for certain heroes and specters are now working as intended.

Duet friendly fire bug:

Duet no longer deals damage to allies.

Inferno Cleave bug:

Inferno cleave now hits all enemies as intended.

Discord link expired:

Discord link in-game now working as intended.

Power train bug:

Power train no longer can deal self-damage.

Endless Assault crit bug:

Endless assault now refreshes when you crit.

Defragmentation Blast tier 2 bug:

Tier 2 now costs 2 instead of 3.

Baby bob Campaign bug:

Baby bob hero highlight now only triggers once as intended.

Cleanse potion bug:

Now correctly removes debuffs for the entire party.

Shadestrike relics bug:

Shadestrike relics now work per turn instead of per battle.

Guardian reflex bug:

Now working as intended.

Serrated webs bug:

Now deals damage when block is applied.

Rekindle bug:

Fixed the amount rekindle heals for.

Restricted + 4-cards in shop relic bug:

Restricted now works as intended even if the player buys the 4-cards in shop relic.

Magmama campaign bug:

Magmama no longer appears incorrectly during the Upgrade bro scene

Loot Goblin soft-lock bug:

Defeating multiple loot goblins in one turn no longer soft-locks the game.

Inferna campaign bug:

Fixed issue where Inferna had no animations during the first encounter in the campaign.

Season 2 episode 6 bug:

99% damage reduction now working as intended.

The High Ground:

Skill now increases crit chance instead of providing a guaranteed crit stack.

Season 4 Episode 2 black box bug:

Fixed black box appearing in background

Battle highlight/catchphrase bug:

Starburst now showing correct catchphrase.

Random damage vs Leviathan bug:

Random target effects can no longer target Leviathan during the first phase.

Unrelenting strike visual bug:

Tier 2 unrelenting strike now correctly shows 1 refresh.

Angry curse bug:

Apocalypse 2 Angry curse now working as intended.

Forecast calls for the pain bug:

Fixed mana consumption issue.

Reform bug: 

Now heals all damage taken as intended. 

Starmane Rainbow Brilliance relic bug:

Relic no longer removes buffs on heroes.

Ragnarath Orb bug:

Defeating orbs with End-of-turn effect now no longer revives orbs.

Thank you everyone for your patience as we tackled bugs and updates addressed by the community!

Team DM

notes.title: Post-launch update, Devs are in full swing!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Dimensionals! 


Thank you so much for all the bug reports, feedback, and suggestions provided so far, both on Steam and Discord since the 1.0 release!!

I wanted to send this announcement out to assure everyone that we are taking a look at these issues seriously and are currently focusing on bugs that are of critical or high priority (crashes, hero unlock issues, hit boxes, skills etc).

Additionally, we are taking a look at some of the core feedback or suggestions such as balancing - particularly within the campaign as well as alternative ways to unlock heroes that is separate from the campaign.

We appreciate all the patience and love shared from the community so far and we hope to better your Dimensionals experience very soon!

I also wanted to take this time to explain our situation we are currently facing at Mino Games and be transparent.

Unfortunately, we weren’t able to achieve the results we were hoping for at early access launch. As such, we had to take the extremely difficult decision that many studios in our industry is facing and decrease the size of the team in order to sustain the project. This decision was not taken lightly and the team has fought like no other for the 1.0 release. For that, we are extremely grateful for past and current team members at Mino Games. 

With that said, we are currently working with a significantly decreased team and as such updates may take some time to implement. As mentioned, we are prioritising the bugs and major concerns users are encountering and will look into suggestions in due time.

In the meantime, we really hope you continue to enjoy your Dimensionals experience and we will fight like crazy to better the experience for all players!

We will do our best to answer questions truthfully that the community may have, thank you as always.

Team DM

notes.title: Dimensionals Major Patch 0.9.1
notes.notes:
Dimensionals Major Patch 0.9.1, Monday Dec 16thNew Additions:    Added VFX to Multiple Backgrounds including the Shop and multiple battles.    New VFX showing when Mana is gained.    New Keyword: Deadly    Skills with Deadly gain a multiplier to Rage and Corruption damage dealt by those skills. For example, if a hero has 5 Rage and they use a skill with Deadly 5, the bonus damage granted by Rage will be 5 x 5 = 25 damage.Updated Features:    Updated Pyropaws starter skill to Flamewreath from Embolden.    Updated how effect stacking and trigger interactions work.    Skills can no longer trigger off themselves, and skills triggered in a chain of events cannot re-trigger the effect of the parent skill.    Dev Note:Skills can no longer create infinite loops or extremely long chains of events. This will not affect the gameplay for the vast majority of players, however it will stop quite a few of the current ways to deal billions of damage across a few turns.   Removed Warp-In and Warp-Out animation delays when entering and exiting the shop.    Minor updates to some Water Skill artwork.    Updated Mode Select screen.    Updated artwork for some Potions and Curses.    New Art for the Mega Heal Potion.    Fixed positions of various Curses to better display the artwork.    Updated some Malliss dialogue poses to prevent some overlap with the text bubbles.    Updated tooltip for the Storm mechanic in the Stratascend fight.    Added some animation batching. If the same animation will play back to back, it will now play a single animation rather than playing it repeatedly.Updated Hero Skill Unlock levels:    Heroes now unlock their new skills at levels 4, 7, 12, 15, 17, and 20 instead of 2, 5, 7, 10, 15, and 20. Dev Note: This change is meant to slightly slow the power gained from a player’s very first run with a set of heroes to prevent them from getting flooded with new build options multiple times in their very first run. Economy Updates: Dev Note: As a whole, gold was far too available for the player, especially in the early game where one could very easily take advantage of how easy it was to obtain a slew of economy-boosting relics in map 1 and by the end of map 2 having enough gold to simply buy a full build and breeze through the remainder of the run. In this patch, we’re drastically toning down the availability of gold to the player throughout the run to make purchases feel a bit more tactical. Relics: Dev Note: The majority of relic updates here are to reduce the power of the Shopkeeper economy relics. notes.title: Dimensionals Hotfix Patch 0.9.0.3
notes.notes:
Greetings Dimensionals!

We’re back again this week for another hotfix patch to address some immediate crash issues. Thank you all for your feedback and suggestions and bug reports over in our Discord server, it has all been tremendously helpful as we continue moving forwards in Early Access. Today’s patch is a relatively small one so let’s dive right in:
New Additions:  Abandon Raid (Title Screen)    
Dev Note: We’ve added a new Abandon Raid button to the title screen to ensure that if players are somehow locked in an infinite loop or an exceptionally long calculation loading screen, they can end their run from the title screen and get back into the game.
    Removed Single Encounter Card options from Map 1 of the Master Raid    
Dev Note: Before players have a chance to get a developed build, sometimes single fights or elites could ruin a run on the spot. We’ve removed the ability for single option rooms to exist in the first map of the Master Raid so there will always be at least 2 options to choose from to ensure a smoother start to your run.
  Crash / Bug / Performance Fixes:  Puff Pow Updated:    
 When any hero deals damage to a target with 30+ Poison, deal 5 Bonus Damage to the target (1, 2, 3) times. Max 10 times per turn. Unique.Dev Note: Puff Pow was drastically overtuned and resulted in a very easy infinite loop by simply owning two of them. Especially in the Rare slot, this level of power was a bit TOO much for Fungass to handle. We’ve reduced the number of hits Puff Pow can deal per rank to 10, 20, and 30 respectively, and given it unique to create some more diversity in Fungass builds. Fortified Poison fixed to no longer trigger off itself leading to instability and crashes. Tainted Flurry reduced to a maximum of 20 hits per cast.Noxious Barrier now has a maximum trigger of 20 times per turn.
 Sporecoating now scales maximum applications per turn with rank.
Rank 1: Limit of 10 times per turn
Rank 2: Limit of 20 times per turn.
Rank 3: Limit of 30 times per turn.Infinite / Near Infinite Calculations crashing the game. 
 We have implemented a two step process here to solve this issue going forwards. We value the stability of Dimensionals and the ability for players to have fun without crashing very highly so we’re approaching this with an immediate fix and a future rework.
  Step 1: This hotfix patch. We are applying a hard limit of 50 procs per skill per turn so nothing can go infinite.      Step 2: A future addition that re-works how passive triggers work to help smooth out the insanity that can come from a long chain of events. We’ll address this more in that patch down the road.   Refactor of the Prediction System:    

 We’ve done an optimization pass on the skill prediction system to reduce some of the resources needed for calculations which should result, when paired with the limit of 100 above, in reduced calculation times and should prevent most further crashes or softlocks.Misc Fixes
 Fixed an issue where Screamweaver was using the icon for War in some attack forecasting.Fixed an issue where using a Corruption potion against Ragnarath could result in a crash.
 Fixed an issue where entering battle against a Skitterer could occasionally cause a black screen.

notes.title: Dimensionals Master Raid Demo Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone and welcome back to another Dimensionals Demo!
Dimensionals is attending the Steam Turn-based fest and with that—the Master Raid demo update is here! Everyone here at Mino is super excited to show off all the progress we’ve made since our last demo! We hope you all have a great time checking out the new Water Dimension heroes, Shork, Bo, and Aquanaut.

You’ll get to play with up to 6 heroes this time around, but just wait—21 heroes will be ready for action when early access drops. With more characters as we develop!

Official Dimensionals Water Dimension Reveal Livestream Last week, we gave a few sneak-peeks of the demo update - check it out as Ruben (Community Manager) and Alex (Game Designer) play through the new update!

[previewyoutube=DD8EjHgDPFU;full][/previewyoutube]

Your Call to Adventure Awaits
Want to keep up-to-date on everything Dimensionals? Catch us on Discord, X, TikTok, and our official site.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926437/5cd5bf0438d5e9939f7bb2b21d08c988de1c47a2.png

Patch Notes
Alongside these new heroes this update also contains a ton of new features and content to go over so let’s break it all down:

New Features:

 3 New Heroes from the Water Dimension
 Shork, Aquanaut, and Bo join the fray as our newest Dimensionals.
 The Water Dimension revolves around using Refresh to cast tons of small damage hits that get amplified by the steady stream of Corruption debuffs that these heroes are able to apply.

 Combo Tracker

The Combo Tracker has been added to better visualize exactly what just went on during a turn when you start to create crazy combos!
 In the top left of your screen, active skills and the subsequent triggers of passive skills will begin to pop up once a skill has been used.  Here you can see exactly what just happened, which triggers occurred, and which hero they are coming from.  
 In future releases we aim to expand this system into a full combat log where you can review past turns and see exactly what’s going on with your build!

 Relics and Curses Implementation
 
 Relics and Curses are a new addition to Dimensionals which offer a new layer of strategy to both the combat and economy.  Relics offer powerful benefits that affect your characters both inside and outside of combat without needing to be equipped by any hero.  
 As long as a Relic (or a Curse) is in your bag, the effect will be active. 
 Curses are similar to relics in the sense that they apply a permanent effect to your heroes as long as that curse is in your bag, however unlike the Relics, Shopkeeper isn’t at all interested in buying your curses so you’re stuck with them until the end.

 Video Tutorial System
 
 Tutorials are something we’ve had in mind for a very long time.  This latest build now offers video tutorials to teach both the basics of gameplay and some of the more nuanced mechanics like upgrading your skills! Let us know if there are more gameplay elements you’d like to see as tutorials to be better prepared for the Rift.

 New Battles and Backgrounds
 There are plenty of brand new battles to test your strategy!

 New Potions

 Consumables have been revamped to make them more accessible and more interesting! Be sure to check in with Potion Granny during your run to see all her new goodies!

 Added Apocalypse mode

For our users looking for a bit more of a challenge we also added a preview of the Apocalypse mode to our Master Raid, where players can forgo the Cosmic Guardian buff at the start of the run and instead begin their adventure with a curse!


General Updates:

 Updated Hero Select screen

 This patch introduces a brand new Hero Select screen.  Drag and drop your heroes to build up your team.  You can also right click on a hero portrait or card to see more info about that hero.

 Skill Revamp for Dimension Zero heroes (Koa, Gramps, and Boop)

 We have completely redesigned the skills for the three Dimension Zero heroes.  Rather than leaning in to a special mechanic, we’ve given Dimension Zero heroes access to a little bit of everything making them great heroes for any team comp. 
 While Dimension Zero heroes have a focus on critical hits, they can also dip into Refresh, Poison, Corruption, Rage, and more to find a way to combo with any of the other heroes in Dimensonals.

 Damage scaling changes (HP, block, damage)

 We’ve continued our quest to rebalance Dimensionals!  We’re aiming for a tough but fair balance where players can feel the risk vs reward of each action they take in combat.
 Hero HP and Block generation has been revisited to keep the gameplay feeling more tactical and keep our battles requiring meaningful strategy in the mid to late game.

 Healing Potions can now be used outside of battles


 A long requested feature is finally upon us! Healing Potions are no longer only for combat.  Heroes can now enjoy a refreshing glass of health in their downtime between battles!

 Update Skill Card Frame Design for Passive Skills

  We have added a new frame design for Passive Skills to better visually separate them from Active Skills, Curses, and Relics.

 UI Improvements

New Potion bag UI Change
Mana Bar visual change

 Skill card SFX improvements

 Combo Meter removed

  The Combo Meter system has been removed while we revisit what exactly we want this system to achieve. Bug Fixes:
 Various Bug Fixes and Improvements

notes.title: Patch Notes - 0.7.0 - Public Playtest
notes.notes:
Welcome back Dimensionals!

We’re so excited to bring you all back into the rift for our latest public playtest! We’ve got some big changes in store for Dimensionals. 

We’re really excited to show you some of the new features we’ve been working on, so excited in-fact that we managed to sneak in two new characters for you all to play with, Koa and Eve!  As a disclaimer, Koa and Eve are in the very early stages of development and therefore include a few placeholder assets, you’ll notice all their Skill Cards are marked with a purple “?”, fear not this is intentional as we wanted you all to get your hands on these newest heroes ASAP.

Alongside these two new heroes comes our first sneak peek at the newest game mode in Dimensionals, the Campaign!  The campaign is something we’ve been working towards in secret for the past little while as a brand new way to experience Dimensionals.  For players who love a fun story, a wide cast of characters, and some extreme challenges, the campaign has something for you.

Each chapter of our campaign explores the story of Dimensionals as our team of heroes travels from, you guessed it, Dimension to Dimension to save the multiverse after a catastrophic attack from the leader of the Specter army, Ragnarath.  In this update we’ll be showing off a small taste of “Chapter 1: Welcome to Atlantis” where you will be able to play the first two Episodes in our story.  In these first two Episodes you play as Koa, teamed up with Shork and Eve, to survey the damage caused by Ragnarath as you dive deep into the waters of Atlantis in search of your Dimensional friends, Bo and Aquanaut.

Our campaign takes on a slightly different structure from the full roguelike approach of our Master Raid game mode, where each Episode is a predefined set of battles, shops, and dialogue that tells a unique story.  Each Campaign Episode has their own set of challenge quests and a leaderboard to show off your high score for that Episode!  We really hope you enjoy this new way to play Dimensionals and can’t wait to hear your feedback.

New Features
 Campaign Mode Demo
 Episode 1 and Episode 2 both have their own unique set of challenges that can be activated, including a Mastery challenge which requires all 5 of the Episode challenges to be active simultaneously! Good luck Dimensionals.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926437/7c425d0f1eaafafb7b06493f90b8ef2797f48bb0.jpg Leaderboards
Players can find one leaderboard per Episode inside the Campaign Demo and a separate Master Raid leaderboard on the main screen.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926437/1f9373a566b037b92ce672ee79e5b3d5924dcee3.png Koa and Eve as playable heroes

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926437/1b4614bb93b3901cd1137d028a43ffe445ec5ddd.png
 New Mechanic: Break
 Break is a debuff that can be applied to enemies by Koa and Eve that increases the damage taken from the next hit the debuffed enemy receives from an active Skill or a Poison hit.  Each stack of Break will further amplify that damage and all stacks are removed when damage is dealt.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926437/f628a0328b0ff1e100eb9f3a59254fb399122fd5.pngGameplay Speed Toggle
 We have increased the pace of our animation triggers substantially and now offer two styles of gameplay, Normal mode and Fast mode.  Normal Mode starts out slower, but the more actions that happen during the turn, the faster they ramp up.  Fast most is as the name suggests, fast.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926437/0a26e9e3414e9668bf437f187de4860dbcbd01d2.pngEnemy Forecast Accuracy
Our forecast system now more accurately shows incoming damage from enemy attacks.  You will now see the true value of the base damage, plus any Rage on the attacker, plus the Corruption your character has, and the damage reduction if they have Weak applied to them. All in all it’s much easier to see the exact damage you need to block each turn!  Paired with this we also have a small visual update to our HP bars when it comes to Poison!  The portion of the HP bar that will be lost to Poison at the start of each turn is highlighted in Green so you can clearly see how much HP will be lost on both enemies and heroes.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926437/e15f6e16cc0ad9d3513e5008870d4cad625fb3dd.pngUpdated Content


 Skill Card Upgrade Logic

We’ve changed the way upgrading works for the Hero Skill Cards. Previously players had to merge two identical Skill Cards together to upgrade them (3* + 3* to make a 4*).  We updated this mechanic slightly so now players can combine any two of the same Skill to upgrade it, however now those upgrades cost a bit of extra gold to offset the previous requirement of finding a lot of extra copies.  All in all this change makes upgrading much more accessible and puts an emphasis on gold management during a run.Mana Update
 Players will now start at 3 mana at the beginning of each battle and gain +1 max mana each turn up until they reach 7 mana.Hero Unlocking
Players will now start with the Atlantis heroes unlocked to use in the Master Raid and will obtain new heroes after defeating each boss.Timewarps have been removed
Timewarps didn’t quite do what we wanted them to do, so we’ve disabled them for now.
Boss and enemy difficulty scaling
The Specters in the rift have gained a bit of power! Be wary Dimensionals.
 Character Death and Revival no longer destroys an equip.
 HP Bar now shows incoming healing from Potions and Skills
 New SFX
 Various UI/UX Improvements
 Terrain background FX updates / polishBug Fixes

 Fixed Class lock icon colour
 Fixed various death animation issues
 Moved Timer Overlay fixed for boss battles
 Fixed various Game crashes during the Ragnarath fight
 Fixed Raging Bob counter attack issues
 Fixed Terrain FX layered on top of characters
 Various Battle highlight animation fixes
 Fixed Fungass Hero highlight
 Fixed Armored rage sometimes not giving Rage each turn for the first time you gain Armor
 Fixed Bubble Barrier animation
 Fixed Hydro Power infinite loop
 Fixed Toxic refresher not working in some cases
 Fixed Starfall not dealing Piercing Damage
 Manaspring now correctly affected by Stasis
 Too Angry to Die now generates block on heroes who gained Rage from Momentum
 Hydro power now works with Stasis
 Suppressing Fire now correctly interacts with Windfury
 Slight text bug fixed on wind powered
 Additional misc bug fixes and optimizations

notes.title: Patch Notes - 0.6.0 - Closed Playtest
notes.notes:
Dimensionals Patch 0.6.0 - Closed Playtest

Hey everyone and welcome to the Closed Playtest patch notes! We’re in the middle of preparing a bunch of big changes to Dimensionals, so ahead of our public playtest next month we’re hosting a small focused playtest to check in with our most engaged players to get their direct feedback on what more we can do to make Dimensionals amazing! If you weren’t selected for this closed beta, be sure to keep your eyes open later on next month for our public playtest to get your hands on the latest Dimensionals content!  

Thank you so much everyone for your feedback, support, and absolute enthusiasm towards Dimensionals, everyone here at Mino really appreciates all the love for our new IP!

See you in the Rift!

New Features

 Codename: The Mothership
We’ve been hard at work concepting out the Dimensionals home away from home, their mothership, tentatively named the Zero-II. From the Zero-II, the leader of the Dimensionals, lovingly known as Gramps, dispatches missions into the rift. This is just a sneak peek of the Mothership and gives a small taste of some of the new content coming to Dimensionals in the coming playtests.


 Challenge Quests
Along with the Mothership comes our first batch of challenges. These are requests from various citizens of the rift that will get you thinking about how to create specific builds to overcome their requests. We have a few easier challenges available like “Say No To Potions” where our favorite slimy space weasel wants to take your business away from his prime competition in the rift, the lovable Potion Granny! For those looking for a slightly harder challenge, we have quests such as Poison Party where you’re tasked with dealing 10,000 poison damage in a single hit. 


 Combo Meter and Scoring
We’ve implemented our first pass at a few new ways to visualize the effectiveness of your build!  First up is the Combo Meter. This system allows you to see the immediate impact of upgrades, new equips, and new combos you discover. Every action you take during a turn increases the Combo Bar, so you get a visual reference to how your build is progressing from fight to fight! Paired with the combo meter is our new scoring system. Certain actions like dealing damage or generating block will add to your score while other actions like gaining rage and applying corruption give you a multiplier to your score for the turn. Pull off your high scores and show off in our Discord for bragging rights!  For right now this system is only local but we’ll be implementing leaderboards for this system in future builds!


 Inventory & hero slot upgrade system
This is a key new feature to chat about. The heroes in Dimensionals are getting some extraplanar help from one of our newest rift creatures, the Cosmic Guardian. After defeating a boss, players will be visited by the Cosmic Guardian and given the ability to either upgrade their inventory size OR add a new equip slot on to a Tank or Support hero bringing them from 3 slots to a new max of 4! These extra slots really open up some huge combo potential as the run progresses! 


 Added Support for Chests to Give 1+ Star Equips
When you got into the later stages of your run, having equips from at 1* just didn’t cut it anymore. Now both chests, and shops have the ability to drop equips at a higher quality rating. The time has come to get absolutely overpowered!


 Chat Picks Your Build (Twitch Polls)
For our Streamers out there, have you ever wanted to really lean in to the wisdom of Twitch Chat and have them dictate how you play the game? Well ponder no longer, we’ve got you covered. In the settings menu, you can link your twitch chat to our game client allowing for your viewers to vote on various aspects of the game. When you get a chest reward, chat votes on what equip you need to pick, or if there are dialogue options in a Mystery Encounter, yup, Twitch gets to vote on that too! Will you risk the lives of your Dimensionals by allowing Twitch Chat to dictate your build? 

General Updates

 Animation Speed increased
This was a massive request, and something we were already deep into fixing.  Here it is, our first iteration of the animation speedups. Turns should no longer take over a minute to end when you have some crazy combo to pull off! We’ll be expanding on this system in future patches to include various speed toggles to find what feels great for you!

 New damage and critical hit animation
 New Terratory SFX and UI SFX
 Shop UI Improvements
 Equip cards now display MAX upgrade
 Updated Equip Card Frame & Description Gradient

 Common: Purple
 Rare: Yellow
 Epic: Red + Animated VFX
 Legendary: Pearl + Animated VFX

 Shop Refresh Logic Update
 Shop Refresh costs are now reset back to their base price after each battle.

 The New Battle Varieties
 Modified Combat Encounter Difficulty
 Equip Balancing and New Equips
 Vulcore and Celestia heroes have some new tools at their disposal! Updated Hero Highlights We slightly decreased the rate at which heroes shout their catchphrases.  Previously even small victories like dealing a critical hit or dealing a decent chunk of damage would have your heroes swoop in and yell!  We’ve dialed back their excitement slightly to have our Dimensional heroes appear a bit less frequently.

 Add tooltip to Quest button on the map
 Mystery Encounter Update - Timekeeper
 Some powerful artifacts might be found in the possession of the Timekeeper.. Upgradebro Mystery Encounter
 We added some text prompts to clarify how he works!
BUG FIXES
 Equip Bug Fixes
 Cautious Recharge now gives proper block values.
 Gale Force equip is not working as intended all ranks.
 Fixed issue with Critical Chain not refreshing equips properly.
 Storm Scythe multihit sometimes is wasted on the enemy that was killed by previous hits. Various stability / crash fixes

notes.title: Patch Notes - 0.5.2 - Public Playtest #1
notes.notes:
Welcome Dimensionals!
Today marks a significant milestone for Dimensionals as we open our doors to the first round of public testing!  We're thrilled to share this early build of the game with you all and can’t wait to hear what you have to say about it! Last month, we conducted a small playtest with a handful of streamers and received valuable feedback that we've incorporated into this public playtest.  Whether you’re brand new to Dimensionals or you experienced it last month during the livestreams, we want to give you all a warm welcome as we invite you to check out the game for yourselves!

For our returning players, or curious newcomers, check out these patch notes below to see what all has changed since your last excursion into the Rift.
New Features

Equip Rarity

We’ve added new border colours and rarity symbols to our cards so players can easily distinguish between Common, Rare, and Epic quality equips.
We’ve also added new VFX shaders to make those Rare and Epic cards really pop!
Add Hero Class icons to hero select:

You can now see the Class Icon beside each hero banner in Character Select
Each class has their own strengths they bring to the team, be sure to mix and match to find what works best for you!
 The Shield Icon indicates the character is a Tank
The Sword Icon indicates the character is an Attacker
The Plus Icon indicates the character is a Support
You can now right to inspect equip upgrades

Players can now Right-Click to inspect an equip to see what each upgrade level looks like!
With this knowledge you can make informed decisions about what equips you want to upgrade to best suit your build.
Inventory size has been increased to 9 slots

The goal of our combat system in Dimensionals is to allow the player to prepare for various situations by having tools at the ready in their inventory.  
Being able to swap equips in and out between battles is a key component of mastering Dimensionals.  You said it and we agreed, more inventory space is here!
Hotkey Support (Phase 1)

 You can now use "ESC" button to close any screen or open the game menu
 You can now use "TAB" button to show / hide inventory on the Map screen.
 We’ll be adding more hotkey support in future patches.
Combat Updates:

 New Battles: The Rift
We’ve added a slew of new battles into the game that don’t take place in any specific Dimension.
 These new Rift battles can be found on any map and provide a handful of new challenges for you to overcome.
Be prepared, even the silliest looking denizens of the rift may surprise you with how tricky they can be.New Enemy Specters: 
Designer Note: With the introduction of the new Rift Battles we’ve got a handful of new Specters to challenge! From the hulking Masher to the slippery Basic Bob, the rift is full of new enemies! Our favorite addition are the Bobs, a race of deep space slimes capable of taking on a variety of attributes.  There’s a loveable little Bob for every occasion, each with their own unique mechanics and personality.
Bob Variants:
Basic Bob

Binding Bob
Toxic Bob
Reflective Bob
Corrupted Bob
Seeker

Masher

Fangcowl, the Constrictor (Rift Elite Battle)Economy Changes
Designer Note: In our first playtest last month the economy was in a pretty generous state. For a universe ravaged by the Specter forces of Ragnarath there sure was a lot of gold just floating around!  We’ve toned back how much gold is freely available to the player to better fit the intended difficulty.  We’ve also reduced the number of items a shopkeeper stocks down to 3 to make it slightly harder to acquire multiple duplicates very early on in the game. These economy changes were made to make each purchase feel more impactful and make the player really consider the best purchases for their current point in time. Rather than being able to freely refresh the shop a multitude of times in the early game to pick up a ton of duplicates, players will now have a slightly lower power spike after Map 1 keeping the game feeling a bit more challenging in the early stages.
